about: Agent Link's own tools kept as data, run by agentlink/runners.py: a wrapper of one FreeCAD command (make, apply, command, read) or a list of steps. Descriptions, schemas and refusals are the tools' own, word for word.

pd_clone.description: A new PartDesign body on another object's shape (PartDesign Clone): from (a body, a Part solid, anything with a shape), at [x,y,z] and axis, angle to place it, name. Its first feature (BaseFeature) follows the original; pd_ features go on top. Reply: body, from, volume.

fields.note: A body built on the other's shape: its BaseFeature follows the original; add pd_ features on top (sketch_new on its planes or faces).

bim_level.description: A level (Building Storey) holding objects (labels), its floor at elevation mm; height: floor to floor. A container, not a lift: BIM components keep their own Z (build an upper storey on points with z); plain shapes put in it move up by the elevation. Then bim_building { levels }.

bim_pipe.description: A pipe swept along points [[x, y, z] …] mm: diameter (50), wall (thickness). Corners are sharp: bim_pipe_connector joins separate pipes with a bend. Answers diameter, length, box.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no pipe.

bim_equipment.description: An object made BIM equipment (furniture, fixtures): object (a shape), ifc (FreeCAD's spaced type name: Furniture, Sanitary Terminal; a wrong one is refused with near names), model, url, watts.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no equipment.

bim_list.description: The BIM objects: each one's label, ifc type, holds (what a level, building or site contains), in (the wall a window or door is set into). Changes nothing.

bim_remove_shape.description: Remove Shape from BIM: structures and walls whose shape is a plain box are rebuilt from their sizes; the new object carries the old one's internal name as its label. Anything else is left as it was.

fields.note: Box-shaped structures and walls among them were rebuilt from their length, width and height and now carry their old internal name as label (object_list shows them); the rest were left as they were.

bim_structural_system.description: One structure copied to every crossing of two axis sets (bim_grid's "Grid X", "Grid Y"), or along one. Its own position is added to each crossing: make it at [0, 0, 0]. structures: one per call. Answers system, copies (0: the axes do not cross).

rules.message: structures: one structure per call (FreeCAD makes a separate system for each); call again for the next.
axes: one or two axis objects (bim_grid makes them: "Grid X", "Grid Y").

bim_pipe_connector.description: A connector where the ends of two pipes meet (an elbow) or three (a tee): pipes (labels), radius of the bend mm (the pipe's diameter when left out). An error state on it means the ends do not meet.

rules.message: pipes: two pipes (an elbow) or three (a tee) whose ends meet at one point; bim_pipe makes them.

meshobj_offset.description: Move a mesh's surface along its point normals by distance mm (negative: inward); triangles the move turns over are collapsed, so a distance beyond the tightest inside radius damages the mesh: meshobj_info after. In place; copy: true makes a new mesh. Reply: offset, the mesh's reading.

mesh.description: The mesh's label; may be left out when there is one.

rules.message: distance: mm along the normals (negative: inward).

draft_to_sketch.description: Draft shapes (or other flat shapes with edges) made into one new sketch on their plane: objects (all flat, in one plane); constrain: true (default) adds coincident, horizontal and vertical constraints where they hold, no dimensions; delete: true removes the originals. Reply: object, geometry, constraints (counts), length, box; sketch_state reads its degrees of freedom.

rules.message: Draft could not make a sketch of those: every object needs a shape, flat, and all in one plane (FreeCAD's report view names which failed). draft_modify op move or part_transform lays them in one plane first.

bim_wall.description: A wall along points [[x, y(, z)] …] mm (closed: true joins the last to the first) or a base sketch/wire: width (200), height (3000). align center | left (the line is the wall's left face going from the first point, so the wall lies to its right) | right. Answers length, box, min, volume_m3, base (the line bim_opening measures along).

rules.message: align: center (the line runs down the middle), left (the line is the wall's left face going from the first point on: the wall lies to the right) or right (the wall lies to the left).
points [[x, y] …] (the wall's line, mm) or base (a sketch or wire's label): one of them.
base: {base.Label} has no edges to run a wall along; give a sketch or wire, or points [[x, y] …].

bim_section.description: A section plane through objects (every BIM object not in a level when left out): at ([0, 0, 1200]), normal ([0, 0, 1]: a plan cut). It draws nothing itself: td_bim puts it on a page; export { section: z } writes a plan cut as DXF/SVG.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no section plane.
normal: a direction, not [0, 0, 0] ([0, 0, 1] for a plan cut, [0, 1, 0] for a section looking along Y).
Nothing to cut: no BIM objects here; give objects, or make some first (bim_wall …).

fields.note: A section plane for TechDraw (td_bim of it) and the FreeCAD window; export { section: z } writes a plan cut as DXF/SVG headless.

bim_reference.description: An external reference: another file's objects shown here and updated with it, not copied. path: the full path of an .FCStd (or .ifc, .dxf); part: one of its parts. Answers reference, file, volume, box.

rules.message: path {path!r}: no such file. Give the full path of an .FCStd (or .ifc, .dxf) to reference.

fields.note: Shown from the other file and kept up to date with it; not copied in.

Whatever preset says, it is a plain frame round a pane or a door panel. Answers wallCut_m3 (0 with a warning: nothing was cut), opening (the cutting box), box, min.

steps.when: =a.type or a.properties or a.classification is not None

bim_quantities.description: Take-off of the BIM model by type | material | both: groups { count, volume_m3, mass_kg (null when a density is missing) }, totalMass_kg; detail: true adds rows with areas and perimeter. Densities come from bim_material / bim_layers. Changes nothing.

let.known: =[r.mass_kg for r in rows if r.get('mass_kg')]

value.fmt: {len(rows) - len(known)} objects have no material density: bim_material or bim_layers gives them one.

bim_preflight.description: Check the model before bim_export (Agent Link's own checks): a site, building or storey; each object's IFC type, solid and valid shape, storey, material, host wall; duplicate labels. Answers ok, issues [{ object, issues }], blocking (fix these first). Changes nothing.

let.bims: =[o for o in doc().Objects if is_bim(o)]

issues.what: no BIM objects in the document
no site, building or storey: IFC needs a spatial structure (bim_building, bim_level)

steps.when: =not (any(k in kinds for k in ('Building', 'Building Storey', 'Site')) or any(proxy_name(o) in ('_Building', '_Floor', '_Site', 'BuildingPart') for o in bims))

=not (pn in ('_Building', '_Floor', '_Site', 'BuildingPart') or t in ('Building', 'Building Storey', 'Site', 'Project') or pn in ('_ArchMaterial', '_ArchMultiMaterial') or o.isDerivedFrom('Spreadsheet::Sheet'))

push.row: no IFC type (exported as a proxy): bim_ifc { type }

else.when: =t not in ('Space', 'Grid', 'Axis', 'Section Plane', 'Annotation') and pn not in ('_Space', '_Axis', '_SectionPlane', '_Grid')

push.row: not a solid (exported as a surface model or skipped)

let.hosts: =[p for p in o.InList if is_bim(p) and o in (list(get(p, 'Subtractions', []) or []) + list(get(p, 'Additions', []) or []))]

push.row: in no storey or building (bim_level { objects })

then.when: =not contained(o) and not hosts and pn != '_Window' and t not in ('Window', 'Door')

push.row: a window or door in no wall

then.when: =has(o, 'Material') and o.Material is None and t not in ('Space',) and pn not in ('_Space', '_Window')

let.blocking: =len([i for i in issues if any(w in ' '.join(i.get('issues', [i.get('what', '')])) for w in ('no shape', 'invalid', 'no site'))])

fields.note: Blocking: no shape, invalid shapes, no spatial structure. The rest exports, but loses meaning in other BIM tools.

bim_edit.description: Change BIM components. op add | subtract { object, with [labels] }: fuse them in or cut them out | cut { object, at, normal }: by a plane, removing the side the normal points to (answers removed_m3) | join { walls, delete }: walls of the same width, height and align into one, the last named kept | clone { object, move }.

then.refuse: object: the wall, slab or structure to change (a BIM component; bim_list shows them).
with: [objects] to join to it (add) or cut from it (subtract).

refuse.fmt: with: {host.Label} itself, or something built on it, cannot be added to or cut from it (a loop).

then.when: =host in others or any(host in x.OutListRecursive for x in others)

steps.when: =proxy_name(x) not in ('_Roof', '_Window') and ifc_type(x) not in ('Window', 'Door', 'Roof')

cut.refuse: object: the BIM component to cut (a wall, slab, structure).

refuse.fmt: object: {host.Label} has no solid to cut.

put.warning: nothing was cut: the plane misses it, or the normal points away (it removes the side the normal points to).

join.refuse: walls: two or more different walls to join into one.
join.when: =len(ws) < 2 or len({w.Name for w in ws}) < len(ws)

join.refuse: FreeCAD would not join them: walls need the same width, height and alignment, and each a line as its base (not a face). bim_edit { op: "add" } fuses unlike walls instead.

clone.refuse: object: the BIM component to clone.

steps.refuse: op: add | subtract (object, with) | cut (object, at, normal: the side it points to goes) | join (walls) | clone (object, move).

bim_component.description: A generic BIM component: kind component { from (an object with a shape), ifcType } | clone { from, at, axis, angle } (follows the original) | unclone { from } (cut loose). Answers object, volume mm³, box.

refuse.fmt: {o.Label} is not a clone (it has no CloneOf): kind clone {{ from }} makes one.

else.refuse: kind: component { from, ifcType } | clone { from, at, axis, angle } | unclone { from }.

bim_panel_out.description: BIM panels for the cutter: kind cut (each panel's flat outline with its tag) | sheet { width, height } (the cuts on one stock sheet, not nested). export { format: "dxf" } writes them.

let.wrong: =[p.Label for p in panels if draft_type(p) != 'Panel']

refuse.fmt: panels: {named_wrong} {verb} not BIM panels; bim_panel makes them.

fields.cuts: =[{'panel': p.Label, 'cut': c.Label, 'edges': len(c.Shape.Edges) if not c.Shape.isNull() else 0} for p, c in zip(panels, cuts)]
fields.note: Flat outlines to cut, with the panel's tag; export to DXF or SVG for the cutter.

steps.refuse: kind: cut { panels } | sheet { panels, width, height }.

bim_nest.description: Nest flat pieces into a sheet: container (one flat face), pieces (objects of exactly one flat face each, the same way up; not solids), rotations to try ([0, 90, 180, 270]). The pieces are moved. margin is not applied (FreeCAD 1.1's nester has none). Slow with many pieces: start with a few.

refuse.fmt: container: {cont.Label} must be one flat face (the sheet), not a solid or a wire: draft_shape makes a rectangle with a face.

let.not_flat: =[p.Label for p in pieces if shape(p) is None or len(p.Shape.Faces) != 1 or p.Shape.Solids]

refuse.fmt: pieces: each must be a single flat face (an outline with a face), not a solid: {named_not_flat}. A panel's outline (its base) is such a face.

steps.refuse: pieces: each piece once, and not the container itself.
steps.when: =len({p.Name for p in pieces}) < len(pieces) or cont in pieces

except.refuse: rotations: degrees to try each piece at, a list such as [0, 90, 180, 270].

steps.refuse: The pieces would not nest: FreeCAD's nester stopped (its reason is in the report view; report_read shows it). Check each piece is a flat face lying the same way up as the sheet, and that the largest fits the sheet.

value.fmt: The pieces did not all fit one sheet: {len(sheets)} sheets' worth were laid out; view_render shows where.

margin.value: not applied: FreeCAD 1.1's nester has no margin. Leave room by nesting into a face smaller than the sheet.

bim_ifc_brep.description: Set whether BIM objects go to IFC as B-rep (plain faces) instead of extrusions: on true | false, toggled when left out.

refuse.fmt: {o.Label} has no IFC data (not a BIM object).

let.on: =a.on if a.on is not None else data.get('FlagForceBrep') != 'True'

fields.note: Forced B-rep objects export to IFC as plain geometry, not parametric extrusions.

bim_views.description: 2D plan views of levels (all storeys when left out): a section plane at cutHeight mm above each one's elevation (1100) and a flat Draft view of it; cutOnly: the cut faces alone. Slow on big levels.

let.levels: =objs(a.levels, 'levels') if a.levels else [o for o in doc().Objects if get(o, 'IfcType', '') == 'Building Storey']

steps.refuse: No levels here: bim_level makes them, or give levels (labels).

fields.note: 2D plan views at the cut height (Draft shape views, flat on Z = 0): export { format: "dxf" } writes them; td_bim draws a section plane on a drawing page.

bim_image_plane.description: An image plane to trace over: path (the image's full path), width and/or height mm (one gives the other), at, axis, angle. Seen in the window only.

refuse.fmt: path {a.path!r}: no such image file; give its full path (png, jpg, bmp, svg).

set.o.XSize: =float(w or (float(h) / ratio if ratio else h))
set.o.YSize: =float(h or (float(w) * ratio if ratio else w))

fields.note: A picture to trace over: a plan, an elevation, a photo with a known length.

bim_library.description: The objects library (the parts_library add-on, or folder): search words find files (answers found [{ name, path }]); insert: a found name or full path brings it into the document.

steps.refuse: No objects library here: give folder (a clone of FreeCAD's parts library), or install parts_library from the Addon Manager.

let.p: =a.insert if isabs(a.insert) else first(h for h in hits if basename(h) == a.insert)

refuse.fmt: insert {a.insert!r}: not found — search first.

let.new: =[o.Label for o in doc().Objects if o.Name not in before]

fields.found: =[{'name': basename(h), 'path': h} for h in hits[:50]]

bim_reextrude.description: Re-extrude a BIM object from one of its faces ("Wall.Face3"): a new wall, panel or structure standing on that face, as deep as the old one, with its material and IFC type; the old one is deleted unless delete: false. Face numbers change when an object is rebuilt.

steps.refuse: face: "Wall.Face3", the object's label, a dot and one of its faces: the face to extrude from again.

steps.make: =maker('Arch.makeWall' if t == 'Wall' else 'Arch.makePanel' if t == 'Panel' else 'Arch.makeStructure')

bim_rewire.description: Rebuild loose lines and wires (objects) as joined wires, one per connected run; the originals are deleted.

let.edges: =[e for o in targets for e in get(o.Shape, 'Edges', [])]

steps.refuse: objects: lines or wires (objects with edges) to join; none of these has an edge.

bim_glue.description: Glue two or more objects' shapes into one plain compound (not fused, no longer parametric); the originals are deleted.

let.targets: =[o for o in objs(a.objects) if o.isDerivedFrom('Part::Feature') and not o.Shape.isNull()]

steps.refuse: objects: two or more objects with shapes to glue into one.

fields.note: One plain shape of them all, no longer parametric.

bim_trash.description: BIM's trash: action put { objects } (moved into a hidden Trash group, still in the document) | list | empty (deleted for good, with children nothing else uses).

bim_reorder.description: Reorder a group's, level's or building's children in the tree: order [labels to put first], or sort: true by label.

order: only {g.Label}'s children — {children}.
